title: Italian Registry of Minimally Invasive Pancreatic Surgery
official: Italian Registry of Minimally Invasive Pancreatic Surgery (IGOMIPS)
summary: Assess the prevalence of minimally invasive pancreatic surgery in the country and its outcomes
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years;
* Underwent minimally invasive pancreatic surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant woman
* Minor or unable to give informed consent
sponsor: Associazione Italiana per lo Studio del Pancreas
